name: Hypopigmentation-punctate Palmoplantar Keratoderma Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of punctate hyperkeratotic lesions on the palms and soles
Hypopigmented macules interspersed within keratoderma lesions on palms and soles
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance
Histopathological confirmation showing epidermal hyperkeratosis with focal hypopigmentation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of punctate palmoplantar keratoderma lesions with associated hypopigmented macules, supported by clinical examination and family history
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical; genetic testing may assist but is not routinely available.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Punctate hyperkeratotic papules on palms and soles
pathognomonic.notes: Discrete, small, keratotic lesions primarily on weight-bearing areas
searchTerms: small rough thickened bumps on hands and feet
tiny hard spots on palm and sole skin

pathognomonic.symptomName: Hypopigmented macules within palmoplantar keratoderma lesions
pathognomonic.notes: Distinct areas of decreased pigmentation interspersed among keratotic lesions
searchTerms: light spots within thickened palm and sole skin
pale patches on thick palmoplantar skin

common.notes: Cracks in thickened skin, especially on soles
searchTerms: mild cracks on palms and soles
slight skin fissures on hands and feet

common.symptomName: Pruritus localized to affected palmoplantar areas
searchTerms: localized itching on hands and feet

common.symptomName: Callus formation on pressure points of palms and soles
common.notes: Thickened skin due to mechanical stress
searchTerms: calluses on pressure points of hands and feet
hardened skin spots on palms and soles
thick skin buildup at pressure sites

occasional.symptomName: Nail dystrophy involving fingernails or toenails

searchTerms: excessive sweating on hands and feet
overactive sweat glands in hands and feet

occasional.symptomName: Mild pain or discomfort on weight-bearing areas
occasional.notes: Discomfort related to thickened skin lesions
searchTerms: mild pain when standing or walking
aching in pressure points of feet

rare.notes: Rare vesiculation in areas of keratoderma

searchTerms: reduced sweating on palms and soles
dry skin due to low sweat in hands and feet

rare.notes: Rare involvement beyond palms and soles
searchTerms: scaly red patches outside palms and soles
psoriasiform skin lesions on non-palm areas

laboratory: Histopathology showing epidermal hyperkeratosis with focal hypopigmentation
other: Clinical examination revealing characteristic punctate keratoderma with hypopigmentation

distinguishingFeatures: Predominantly hyperkeratotic lesions without pigmentary changes
Lesions not limited to palms and soles

redFlags: Development of ulcerations or persistent fissures
references: Elder DE, et al. Lever's Histopathology of the Skin. 11th Edition. 2014.
Haftek M, et al. Clinical and histopathological features of punctate palmoplantar keratoderma with hypopigmentation. J Eur Acad Dermatol Venereol. 2020.
